notes.title: Vita: Rift of a Nation Update 2025 is now LIVE
notes.notes:
Happy Anniversary!

Today marks the one-year Anniversary of Vita: Rift of a Nation being on Steam. To celebrate; Update 2025 is now live!

I released the patch notes last week of everything that was coming out. I hope you enjoy the new side quest and the End Game Boss Rush mode as well as the enhanced Sprites. 

Thank you all for your support.

notes.title: Vita: Rift of a Nation Update 2025
notes.notes:
On February 2nd, 2025 will be the one year anniversary of Vita: Rift of a Nation. To celebrate. I'll be releasing this year's update. 

Sprite Enhancements:
Sprites are now slightly taller making them and their detail easier to see. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44834028/83cec27ba873053ec8c259e5ff8931f7bc5b13fe.png[/img]

New Side Quest:
There are a total of three (3) new side quests. One (1) in each biome. 
These side quests will give you a glimpse into other parts of the continent of Naprina. It will also introduce a new enemy type. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44834028/b72133a624d538bb052069cdb39bd08cec361570.png[/img]

Boss Rush:
Boss Rush will be playable near the end of the game. It features three (3) levels. Each level gets slightly longer and features new enemies near the end. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44834028/716851bdb9b029deed10a0b4ab9bbe5e64f123cf.png[/img]

Vita: Rift of a Nation Update 2025 will be available on February 2nd, 2025

notes.title: Hot Fix - Patch 05
notes.notes:
Hot Fix - Patch 05

It was brought to my attention that one of the fights thresholds was a bit too low. This has been fixed. 

- Modified a few more move routes for players during cut scenes.

- increased the threshold for Naysa-Dae's health during the first Unok fight in Kindo Jungle.

- Modified the same fight to ignore turn count and only focus on Naysa-Dae's health.
(This one needs a little explaining. it was originally set up that her health needed to be at or below 25% and be between turns 7, 8 or 15.  The turn condition has been removed and the fight will end when her health reaches 40%)

- Placed a small indicator for a hidden item.
(I'm not going to give it away. But it's in one of the deserts. if found. I recommend not using this item during the Unok fight, as it will last a really long time. That fight is designed to not be beaten the first time though it.)

As always. Thank you for playing my game. If you have trouble or something isn't working right. Please feel free to leave something in the community hub. I check it multiple times a day and will respond. I make games for the players so it is important for me to hear my audience and fix things that aren't working right.
